{{Quote|If you're going out there, I'll make it short and sweet. Your fellow Padawans are going to need your help. The Flesh Raiders moved into the training grounds organized and ready, attempting to isolate various groups of Padawans. There's a group of students in the hills we lost track of. They're not combat trained.|Relnex|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Relnex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The beacon worked and a rescue speeder is on its way. You really came through for those Padawans.|Relnex|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Relnex was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Master Relnex returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

Stationed at the [[Gnarls Outpost|training ground]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], Master Relnex fought against the native [[Flesh Raider]]s as they made aggressive attacks on the Order's territories. He carried a scar across his left cheek, testament to his time in battle during the war.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This isn't about aggression, Padawan, remember that.|Relnex|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Relnex considered the Flesh Raiders savages, but sent the Padawan out on a rescue mission, not one of aggression. The Jedi Master had light skin, [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|I've got a beacon here. If you can find the Padawans and set the beacon, we'll send an evac shuttle fast as we can. A group of Jedi from the temple is headed this way but maybe not fast enough. May the Force be with you.|Relnex|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Relnex wore brown and tan hooded [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] including a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]], brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and brown [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]]. The Jedi had a signal beacon and used a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a gray [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] ending in a golden [[Blade emitter/Legends|emitter]] and belt loop.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Padawans are a bit shaky, but they're alive. They wanted to stay so I cleared them a path.''"<br />"''That's brave of them&mdash;but not what the Council wanted. I hope they'll be alright.|The player and Relnex if the Dark Side option is chosen in "Early Lessons"|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Relnex appeared in the optional quest "Early Lessons" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Only players of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] or [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] class may take the quest and Relnex has a unique line of acknowledging each class. Following Relnex's orders and sending the Padawans to safety is considered the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] option during the quest and this article therefore assumes it is the choice players made.<ref name="TOR" />

There is also a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] option in which the players agree to aid the Padawans in fighting the Flesh Raiders, killing ten of the natives and destroying three sets of their supplies. The player can then tell Relnex about the choice they made, and although it was not what the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] wanted, the Jedi Master accepts it and hopes for the safety of the Padawans while they are still out in the Gnarls. The player then has the choice to tell Relnex that the trio will return angry, which the watchman promises to pass along to their masters.<ref name="TOR" />
